ns2:course.label: Internship Seminar
ns2:course.description: Seminar based on internship experience. Offered for College of Media students who complete an approved internship. No graduate credit. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in the same term to a maximum of 2 undergraduate hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 3 undergraduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
